name: The Vampire's Pet
source:
You recently got out of a bad long-term relationship, and your friend Millie is taking you out to a club to help you get over him. Before long, however, she gets distracted and leaves you alone at the bar.

That's when you're approached by a tall beautiful stranger...

[From [url=https://daylily-girl.itch.io/the-vampires-pet]itch.io[/url]]
